stow.translation:
vt. 收藏, 装填, 贮藏, 装满, 使暂留, 堆垛
[经] 堆装, 装载

stow cargo in the hold.translation: [经] 将货物堆装在船舱里

stowage.definition:
n. the charge for stowing goods
n. the act of packing or storing away
stowage.translation:
n. 装载, 装货, 装载方法, 装载物
[经] 堆装(法), 装载(法), 贮藏(法)

stowaway.definition: n. a person who hides aboard a ship or plane in the hope of getting free passage
stowaway.translation:
n. 偷渡者, 匿身处
[法] 偷乘火车, 轮船的人, 偷渡者

stowaways.definition: n. a person who hides aboard a ship or plane in the hope of getting free passage
stowaways.translation: n. 偷乘船[飞机]者( stowaway的复数形式 )

stowboard.definition: n. A place into which rubbish is put.

stowce.definition:
n. A windlass.
n. A wooden landmark, to indicate possession of mining land.

stowe.definition: n. United States writer of a novel about slavery that advanced the abolitionists' cause (1811-1896)
stowe.translation: n. 斯陀园（英国的园林名字）；斯托（地名, 滑雪胜地）；史杜威（姓氏）

stowed.translation: v. 装( stow的过去式和过去分词 ); 装载; 无票偷乘（交通工具, 尤指船或飞机）; 将某物收好（或保存好）

stowing.definition:
p. pr. & vb. n. of Stow
n. A method of working in which the waste is packed into the
   space formed by excavating the vein.
stowing.translation: v. 装( stow的现在分词 ); 装载; 无票偷乘（交通工具, 尤指船或飞机）; 将某物收好（或保存好）

stows.translation: v. 装( stow的第三人称单数 ); 装载; 无票偷乘（交通工具, 尤指船或飞机）; 将某物收好（或保存好）
